name: Sparse Voxel Octree Construction (Basic Version)
definition: An algorithm to construct a Sparse Voxel Octree from a stream of non-empty voxel Morton codes by maintaining queues per depth level, merging nodes when a queue fills up, and writing non-empty nodes to disk.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Construction (Basic Version) builds an SVO from a voxel stream using per-level queues to merge nodes, avoiding global sorting and full in-memory storage.
